moved.release-pipeline: .github/workflows/build.yml (one workflow for APK, desktop and web bundle; replaces release.yml, see notes)
moved.logos: branding/logo.json, branding/emblems/cut.json, scripts/gen-icons.mjs, scripts/logo/lib.mjs (verbatim); outputs: public/icon*.{svg,png}, build/icon.png (electron-builder picks it up), android/app/src/main/res (adaptive vector foreground, notification icon, legacy launcher PNGs)

notes: TurboCut is a vanilla TypeScript app (no React, no Tailwind), so the engine's React files are followed as conventions, not copied: hook classes, tab recipe, dialog structure, panel cards, asset naming, version scheme, docs layout, guides inside Settings. Differences on purpose: (1) builds also run for claude/** branches and publish pre-releases, because the owner tests every branch on a phone; (2) no auto-pr.yml, the owner does not want pull requests unless asked; (3) check.yml is ci.yml and runs on every push; (4) turbothemes is installed from turboengine#path:/themes (moved 2026-10-14; the retired TurboNZL/turbothemes repository no longer exists); (5) editions, window-frame, settings-shell and android-shell are not used: TurboCut has one edition, a native-looking window, and a plain Capacitor Android shell. (6) logos: taken from engine fca5507 with a 'cut' emblem (a play button split by a slanted cut); the Android adaptive icon now uses the generated vector foreground (@drawable/ic_launcher_foreground) and the colour in values/colors.xml, so Capacitor's default drawable-v24 foreground, values/ic_launcher_background.xml and mipmap-*/ic_launcher_foreground.png were removed (a duplicate would fail the resource merge); the Android build itself was NOT run, only the resource references were checked by script.
